cp /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-romanbova-Documents-Code-argos/c2dec188-cca3-4a4a-a6e6-c0b36d0d6b6c/scratchpad/settings.before-capture.json ~/.claude/settings.json && echo restored; cd /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-romanbova-Documents-Code-argos/c2dec188-cca3-4a4a-a6e6-c0b36d0d6b6c/scratchpad && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
for line in open('capture.jsonl'):
    line=line.strip()
    if not line: continue
    try: d=json.loads(line)
    except Exception as e: print('bad line',line[:100]); continue
    tr=d.get('tool_response')
    def shape(x,depth=0):
        if isinstance(x,dict): return {k:shape(v,depth+1) for k,v in x.items()}
        if isinstance(x,list): return [shape(x[0],depth+1)] if x else []
        if isinstance(x,str): return f"str({len(x)}): {x[:60]!r}"
        return x
    print(d.get('tool_name'), 'input keys:', list(d.get('tool_input',{}).keys()))
    print('  top keys:', sorted(d.keys()))
    print('  tool_response:', json.dumps(shape(tr),ensure_ascii=False)[:700])
EOF
tool_input.description: Restore settings and print captured tool_response shapes
